title: Bunny Learns to Finish
moral: Finishing what you start leads to better results.

scenes.summary: Bunny enjoys starting many activities but never finishes them.
scenes.text:
Bunny the Rabbit Who Didn’t Finish Things

In a green meadow full of flowers, lived a cheerful rabbit named Bunny.

Bunny loved to start new things.

He started digging holes…

He started building little nests…

He started collecting carrots…

But there was one problem…

Bunny never finished anything.
scenes.image_prompt: cute rabbit starting many activities like digging and collecting carrots in colorful meadow, cartoon style

scenes.summary: Bunny keeps leaving tasks unfinished despite his friend’s advice.
scenes.text:
One day, Bunny began digging a burrow.

Dig! Dig! Dig!

But soon, he got bored.

“I’ll finish it later,” he said.

Then he started something else.

A carrot pile!

But halfway through…

“I’ll do this later too,” he said.

Soon, Bunny’s meadow was full of half-done things.

Half-dug holes.

Half-built nests.

Half-collected carrots.

His friend Mimi the Mouse came by.

“Why don’t you finish one thing first?” she asked.

Bunny shrugged.

“I like starting new things!”
scenes.image_prompt: messy meadow with unfinished tasks while mouse talks to rabbit, playful cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Rain begins and Bunny realizes his unfinished burrow is a problem.
scenes.text:
One day, dark clouds filled the sky.

Rain began to fall.

Drip! Drop! Splash!

Bunny ran to his burrow—

But it wasn’t finished!

Water started filling the hole.

“Oh no!” Bunny cried.
scenes.image_prompt: rain falling on rabbit trying to enter unfinished burrow filling with water, cartoon style

scenes.summary: Mimi helps Bunny finish the burrow just in time.
scenes.text:
Mimi quickly came over.

“Let’s fix this!” she said.

Together, they worked fast.

Dig! Pack! Cover!

They finished the burrow just in time.
scenes.image_prompt: rabbit and mouse working together to fix burrow in rain, teamwork cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Bunny learns to finish tasks and improves his habits.
scenes.text:
Bunny sat inside, safe and dry.

“Thank you,” he said.

“I should have finished it earlier.”

Mimi smiled.

“Start small… and finish it.”

Bunny nodded.

“I will!”

From that day on, Bunny finished what he started.

And everything worked much better.

Finishing what you start is important.

Small efforts can lead to big results.

The End
scenes.image_prompt: happy rabbit sitting in completed burrow with mouse, cozy and dry, bright cartoon style
